lines.en: I walk the way you walk.

lines.zh: 脚落地的轻重，我都记下了。
lines.en: I've noted how heavily your feet land.

lines.zh: 我走在竹子之间，不出声。
lines.en: I move between the bamboo without a sound.

lines.zh: 玄武岩的黑灰，盖住了我的影子。
lines.en: Basalt dust covers my shadow.
I take the path you didn't.
Three steps, then I copy your pause.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土，粘在我脚上。
lines.en: Red badland clay sticks to my feet.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的节奏，慢半拍。
lines.en: I keep your rhythm, half a beat late.
I walk toward the sound.
I step in your footprints.
I walk very much like a person.
Bamboo leaves rustle. I stop.
I stand, copying your posture.

lines.zh: 我练你的声音，练了很多遍。
lines.en: I've practised your voice many times.

lines.zh: 看看我的肩，是不是很像。
lines.en: Look at my shoulders. Close enough?

lines.zh: 我一个人待着，就练走路。
lines.en: When alone, I practise walking.
The earth here is red.
I'm most human when I don't move.

lines.zh: 有声音从远处传来，我记下来。
lines.en: A voice from far off. I memorize it.
I tilt my head at your angle.

lines.zh: 我数着呼吸，学它的长短。
lines.en: I count breaths and copy their length.

lines.zh: 玄武岩的柱子，挡得住我。
lines.en: The basalt columns can hide me.
This face of mine. Almost right.
Your tone. I'll practise it again.

lines.zh: 我对着水洼，练你的侧脸。
lines.en: I practice your profile in a puddle.

lines.zh: 我听着自己的声音，觉得不对。
lines.en: I hear my own voice. Something's off.
You speak. I'll say it back.
Does this sound like you?

lines.zh: 你的手这样抬，我也这样。
lines.en: Your hand lifts like this. So does mine.
I just called your name.

lines.zh: 你是不是听见有人叫你？
lines.en: Did you hear someone call you?
I'm getting better at it.
Your shadow is on my side.
Don't stare at my face.
This face isn't finished yet.
Smile. Let me try that.
Doesn't it seem familiar?

lines.zh: 我连你走路的样子都会了。
lines.en: I even have your walk now.

lines.zh: 这样站着，我们像不像两个？
lines.en: Standing like this, do we look like two?
Your voice. I have a use for it.
I copy you because I want to be near.
You've stopped talking.
You're silent. Then I'll speak.
While I speak, don't move.
That one. Close, wasn't it?
I've finished today's practice.
I'm hurt the way you get hurt.
My posture slipped for a moment.
A crack in this face.
I hurry to patch it.

lines.zh: 脸被打塌一块，我照着补。
lines.en: A chunk of my face caves in; I patch it by copying.
I retreat the way you retreat.
The closer the copy, the harder to repair.
I mustn't damage your shape.
I'm still here. Just not as convincing.
Again. I can still learn.

lines.zh: 你拿着东西的样子，我学了。
lines.en: I've copied how you hold things.

lines.zh: 你说这几个字的时候，会伸手。
lines.en: When you say that, you reach out.

lines.zh: 我学你伸手，指头分毫不差。
lines.en: I copy your reach, finger for finger.
If you hand it over, I'll have learned it.

lines.zh: 这个动作，我做得比你像。
lines.en: I do this gesture better than you.
Back up a little. I can't reach.

lines.zh: 竹林里，我学你的样子走。
lines.en: In the bamboo, I walk the way you do.
Eating is the hardest thing to copy.
Don't give it to me. I'd hold it wrong.
Show me once more.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，会以为碰到了自己。
lines.en: Touch me and you'll think you touched yourself.

lines.zh: 我退开的姿势，跟你一样。
lines.en: I back away just as you do.
Don't push. I can't imitate that.
We brush past like a mirror.
That bump ruined my posture.
I hurry to copy it again.
You turn sideways. So do I.
We're stuck in the same spot.
You step back. I step back.
Stand off. You're too real.

lines.zh: 我们两个，分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: The two of us — no telling who's who.
You speak, and I speak with you.
We imitate each other.

lines.zh: 这张脸，我可以照着你改。
lines.en: I can shape this face after yours.
Don't be afraid. I only want to be the same.
You raise your right hand; so do I.
In time you won't be able to tell.
You can't tell us apart. Perfect.
I'll keep your voice the longest.
Let's not say the same things.
I bend the way you bend.

lines.zh: 捡起来的手法，也不一样。
lines.en: Even picking things up differs. Hand to hand.
I'll hold it. See if it looks right.
I practised this a long time.
Too heavy. Your posture would change.

lines.zh: 我放回去，照原来的位置。
lines.en: I put it back exactly where it was.
You dropped something. I know.

lines.zh: 它落地的时候，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard it land.
I'll pick it up the way you would.
Here. Use your own hand.

lines.zh: 你的声音，我从很远就听见。
lines.en: I heard your voice from far off.
I call to myself in your voice.
You looked back. I was waiting.
I stand where you walked.
I make my shadow match yours.
I'm already very close.
A little closer and no one could tell.

lines.zh: 恶地的红沙里，我学你的声音。
lines.en: In red badland sand, I copy your voice.
That voice calling you was me.
You turned around.
Now I'm behind you.
You've learned to look back too.
This time I don't need to imitate.
I have all your movements.
From the first step to the last.
I can begin.
I follow, steps matching.
You stop, and I copy the stop.
You can't hear two sets of footsteps.
I copy your breathing.

lines.zh: 这样你就不觉得多了一个。
lines.en: Then you won't feel there's one extra.
In bamboo, sound circles.
I stand behind the basalt.
When you turn your head, I match it.
You're starting to doubt now.
You doubt your own ears.
You doubt yourself. That's best.
Only one set of prints in the red clay.
I'm very close.
Close enough to hear your heart.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，跟我学的不一样。
lines.en: Yours doesn't match the one I learned.
I'll have to learn it again.
This time, from the inside.
Don't move. Let me finish learning.
Nearly done. Don't move.
Done. Now you can't tell.
I strike you with your own hand.
That blow had your exact form.

lines.zh: 你抬手的角度，我背下来了。
lines.en: I memorized the angle of your arm.

lines.zh: 我打你的方式，是你打人的方式。
lines.en: I hit the way you hit.
You blocked. Familiar, isn't it.
I learn fast.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我也退一步。
lines.en: You take a step back. So do I.
Then we're the same.
Hit again and I'll learn again.

lines.zh: 我学的这个样子，不会累。
lines.en: This shape I copied doesn't tire.
I've taken all your moves.
Now I'll use them.
Do you recognize this set?
It's your own.

lines.zh: 别躲，你躲的姿势我也有。
lines.en: Don't dodge. I have your dodge too.

lines.zh: 你会的招式，到这里结束。
lines.en: Your moves end here.

lines.zh: 我先学了一个人的声音。
lines.en: First I learned someone's voice.
Then his walk.
Badland wind lifts the dust.

lines.zh: 我站在红土上，试着说话。
lines.en: I stand on the red clay and try speaking.
Bamboo shadows stretch long.
Basalt black hides a person well.

lines.zh: 我照着一个人做了一副样子。
lines.en: I built a shape after someone.
Almost there. I keep practising.
Someone's walking over from far off.
First, let me see his shoulders.
Then listen to his steps.
I record all of it.
This face takes shape, slowly.
Wait. Still not right.
Almost. One more correction.
Done. Now I step out.
My walk looks very human.
You'll see me and think you know me.
It's close. That's right.
I've called your name.
Fire swept in and my edges curled.

lines.zh: 摔下去，我落地时不像人。
lines.en: I fell, and I didn't land like a person.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，还在学怎么浮。
lines.en: I sink, still learning how to float.
The blast knocked me out of shape.

lines.zh: 有东西钉进我这副样子里。
lines.en: Something's stuck in this shape of mine.

lines.zh: 那光一照，我学的都褪了。
lines.en: That light made everything I'd learned fade.
I don't eat, but I thin out.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我僵成那个人的样子。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I froze in that person's shape.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以照着学的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing here to copy.
